summary: A tool that finds skin foundation makeup on Amazon, builds a product list with a sublist of shades, extracts a hex color per shade, and plots the shades on a generated color-map image (red left, yellow middle, green right, white top, black bottom).

workspaceSignals.decisionReason: The workspace is empty, so this is a new project.

questions.question: Which programming language for Foundation Collector API?
questions.rationale: Python has the best image-processing and color-conversion libraries for hex extraction and image generation.

options.label: Python
options.description: Python on Azure Functions, strong image/color libraries (Pillow, scikit-image)

questions.question: Describe the features or API routes for Foundation Collector API.
questions.answer:
Search Amazon for skin foundation products via the Product Advertising API; list products; list shades per product; extract hex code from each shade swatch image; generate the color-map image (red left, yellow middle, green right, white top, black bottom); place each shade on the map by its hex color.
Example foundation: https://www.amazon.com/Est%C3%A9e-Lauder-Foundation-Long-Wear-Breathable/dp/B0GQVP8RLD/
questions.rationale: Distilled from the user's prompt; the official Amazon API is assumed because scraping Amazon pages violates its terms.
questions.recommendedChoice: Search Amazon for skin foundation products via the Product Advertising API; list products; list shades per product; extract hex code from each shade swatch image; generate the color-map image (red left, yellow middle, green right, white top, black bottom); place each shade on the map by its hex color.

questions.question: Which programming language for Shade Map Viewer?
questions.rationale: TypeScript is the common choice for modern SPAs.

questions.question: Which frontend framework for Shade Map Viewer?
questions.rationale: React is the most common pick for a SPA with an API on Azure.

questions.question: Describe the features or pages for Shade Map Viewer.
questions.answer: Search form; product list with expandable shade sublist and hex swatches; color-map image view with shades plotted as markers.
questions.rationale: Needed to display the product list, shade sublist, and the mapped image.
questions.recommendedChoice: Search form; product list with expandable shade sublist and hex swatches; color-map image view with shades plotted as markers.

questions.question: Which data stores does your app need?
questions.rationale: Products and shades with hex codes are relational (PostgreSQL); the generated map image and swatch images need Blob Storage, which Azure Functions also requires.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The app does not persist data or use storage, queues, or caches

questions.question: Does this app need user login?
questions.rationale: A single-user product research tool with no private per-user data.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Add a user sign-in flow and authenticated API access

options.label: No
options.description: No user sign-in or authenticated API access
